Who has won the most caps for Spain?

Which Dutchman overtook Robin van Persie's 50 goals for the Netherlands with a brace in Lithuania in 2025?
easy.sub: He had equalled the record against Malta in June 2025 and passed it in Kaunas that September.

easy.q: Who scored five of Spain's eight goals on the way to winning the 2010 World Cup?
easy.sub: He took Spain's scoring record off Raul in 2011 and finished on 59 goals in 98 caps.

easy.q: Which Morocco captain won the 1976 Africa Cup of Nations and was African Footballer of the Year in 1975?
easy.sub: He played his whole career at Chabab Mohammedia and was voted best player of the 1976 tournament.

easy.q: Which MVV striker of the 1960s and 1970s was known as the blond arrow?
easy.sub: Dutch Footballer of the Year in 1973. Rinus Michels kept leaving him out of the national side.

easy.q: Which ground did MVV leave for De Geusselt in 1961?
easy.sub: The last match there was a 3-3 draw with PSV on Boxing Day 1960. A stand still carries the name.

easy.q: MVV were relegated from the Eredivisie in 2000. Which division did they drop into?
easy.sub: Dave Hollanders scored their last top-flight goal that season, against Willem II.

easy.q: In which city do Las Palmas play their home games?
easy.sub: The Estadio de Gran Canaria, owned by the Cabildo, opened in 2003 with a friendly against Anderlecht.

easy.q: Which club won La Liga in 1968-69, nine points clear of runners-up Las Palmas?
easy.sub: Their fourteenth title. Las Palmas's top scorer that season got 11 goals.

easy.q: Which country did Morocco knock out of the 2026 World Cup on penalties in Monterrey?
easy.sub: Ismael Saibari scored the winning penalty. It was Achraf Hakimi's 100th cap.

easy.q: Which country beat Morocco in the quarter-finals of the 2026 World Cup?
easy.sub: Morocco were the first African side to reach two World Cup quarter-finals in a row.

easy.q: In which city did Morocco play the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final?
easy.sub: The Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium, with 66,526 inside.

easy.q: Who captained the Netherlands to the European title in 1988?
easy.sub: He scored the opener in the final in Munich, before Van Basten's volley.

easy.q: Which country beat the Netherlands in the 1978 World Cup final?
easy.sub: Dick Nanninga, later an MVV player, scored the Dutch equaliser in Buenos Aires.

easy.q: Who resigned as Netherlands manager the day after their 2026 World Cup exit?
easy.sub: They had topped their group, then lost a round of 32 shootout to Morocco in Monterrey.

easy.q: What is the Spain national team's modern nickname, from the colour of their shirts?
easy.sub: It took hold under Luis Aragones in the 2000s. The older nickname was La Furia.

easy.q: Who scored the only goal of the 2026 World Cup final, in the 106th minute?
easy.sub: Nico Williams headed it to him. Rodri took the Golden Ball and lifted the trophy as captain.

easy.q: Who was Spain's head coach when they won the 2026 World Cup?
easy.sub: He had already won Euro 2024. Spain conceded one goal in eight matches in 2026.

normal.sub: The header came off a Daley Blind long ball, with Casillas off his line. He finished on 50 Dutch goals.

normal.q: Which goalkeeper won 130 caps for the Netherlands between 1995 and 2008?
normal.sub: He retired after Euro 2008, then came back in the October for two qualifiers during an injury crisis.

normal.q: Which Real Madrid striker scored 44 goals for Spain but never won a tournament with them?
normal.sub: His last cap came in September 2006, after a falling out with Luis Aragones over team rules.

normal.q: Which goalkeeper won 167 caps for Spain between 2000 and 2016?
normal.sub: He was the first goalkeeper to reach 100 international clean sheets, and captain from 2008.

normal.q: Which Morocco striker scored the extra-time winner for Olympiacos in the 2024 Conference League final?
normal.sub: A 1-0 win over Fiorentina, the first major European trophy won by a Greek club.

normal.q: Who scored the winning penalty, a panenka, in Morocco's 2022 World Cup shootout against Spain?
normal.sub: Spain did not score a single penalty. Morocco went on to be the first African semi-finalists.

hard.q: Which player makes the top eight for BOTH caps and goals for the Netherlands?
Name any three of the five most capped Spanish players.
hard.a: Sergio Ramos (180), Iker Casillas (167), Sergio Busquets (143), Xavi (133), Andrés Iniesta (131)

hard.q: Which player makes the top eight for BOTH caps and goals for Spain?

hard.a: Noureddine Naybet (115), Achraf Hakimi (102), Yassine Bounou (96), Ahmed Faras (94), Youssef En-Nesyri (92)

Which Dutch forward scored 35 goals in only 38 internationals?
hard.sub: Nearly a goal a game, by far the best ratio of anyone in the Netherlands' top ten scorers.

hard.q: Which Dutch defender missed a penalty in normal time and another in the shootout in the Euro 2000 semi-final?
hard.sub: Italy went through with ten men. De Boer finished his career on 112 caps.

hard.q: Which Spain striker scored in both the Euro 2008 final and the Euro 2012 final?
hard.sub: The winner against Germany in 2008 and the third goal against Italy in 2012. He finished on 38 goals.

hard.q: Who scored twice in Morocco's 3-0 win over Scotland at the 1998 World Cup?
hard.sub: Abdeljalil Hadda got the other. Morocco went out all the same.

extreme.q: MVV went unbeaten in the 1970 Intertoto Cup, four wins and two draws. Why did they not win it?
extreme.a: No knockout rounds were played that year, so no winner was declared
extreme.sub: They topped group A4 ahead of Zilina, Orebro and Waregem.

The Netherlands finished third at the UEFA European Championship. Name a year.

ball.q: Which MVV goalkeeper's clearance bounced all the way in against FC Den Bosch in 1997, voted goal of the year?
ball.sub: Den Bosch had led through a young Ruud van Nistelrooy. MVV won 2-1 and went on to win the division.

ball.q: MVV's chairman was held for questioning in the 1993 fraud raids on the club. Which Maastricht body did he later chair?
ball.a: The Executive Board of Maastricht University
ball.sub: Karl Dittrich led the university from 1995 to 2003. Only the club bookkeeper was convicted.

ball.q: How many points was MVV docked at the start of the 2010-11 season?
ball.sub: The KNVB had blocked a Turkish takeover, and the city bought the stadium to keep the club alive.

ball.q: Which MVV one-club man, there from 1963 to 1985, went on to coach Nigeria to Olympic gold?
ball.sub: Atlanta 1996. He played 335 league games for MVV and for nobody else.

ball.q: Which Belgium captain played for MVV in 1985, between a bribery scandal ban and a move to PSV?
ball.sub: The Standard Liege affair cost him his place at AC Milan. He won 86 caps for Belgium.

ball.q: Which two brothers, grandsons of Bert van Marwijk, made their professional debuts at MVV?
ball.sub: Their father Mark van Bommel started at Fortuna Sittard. Bert van Marwijk played 225 games for MVV.

ball.q: MVV wore a special shirt in February 2023, the first in more than 120 years. What was it for?
ball.sub: White with red, yellow and green bands, worn against TOP Oss.

ball.q: Las Palmas were 90 seconds from promotion in the 2014 play-off final when their own fans ran on. What happened?
ball.a: Play restarted after a long delay and Cordoba equalised at 90+3 to go up instead
ball.sub: The referee threatened to abandon it. One local headline blamed a handful of lunatics.

ball.q: Why did Vitolo spend the first half of 2017-18 on loan at Las Palmas after signing for Atletico Madrid?
ball.a: Atletico were under a transfer ban and could not register him until January
ball.sub: He had triggered his own 37.5 million euro release clause at Sevilla, who threatened to sue.

ball.q: The Las Palmas nickname Pio-Pio came from one supporter at a derby with Tenerife. What was he doing?
ball.a: Chirping like a canary back at the Tenerife fans for the whole match
ball.sub: The fan was known as Fernando el Bandera. The mascot of the same name arrived in 1994.

ball.q: Which Dutchman was managing Barcelona when they beat Las Palmas in the 1978 Copa del Rey final?
ball.sub: Las Palmas were managed by the Real Madrid legend Miguel Munoz. All four goals came in the first half.

ball.q: In which season did Las Palmas and CD Tenerife meet in La Liga for the first time?
ball.sub: Those two games were still the only top-flight Canary Islands derbies ever played by 2026.

ball.q: Where was Pedri born, before he joined the Las Palmas academy?
ball.sub: Bajamar, on the rival island. Barcelona agreed a 5 million euro deal for him at 16.

ball.q: CAF awarded Morocco the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final 3-0 in March, two months after they lost it on the pitch. Why?
ball.a: Senegal had walked off in protest, and the appeal board ruled that they had forfeited
ball.sub: Rabat, January 2026. Senegal came back on and won 1-0 in extra time. Their own appeal went to CAS.

ball.q: Achraf Hakimi was banned for two matches for his conduct in the rainy 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final. What had he done?
ball.a: Blocked attempts to get a towel to the Senegal goalkeeper
ball.sub: Ismael Saibari was in on it too. CAF called it unsporting conduct.

ball.q: Morocco beat Scotland 3-0 at the 1998 World Cup and still went out. Which country's late win over Brazil did it?
ball.sub: Morocco were second with ten minutes to go in the group. Norway scored twice late to take the place.

ball.q: Morocco topped a 1986 World Cup group with England, Poland and Portugal. Who then knocked them out?
ball.sub: Lothar Matthaus scored in the 88th minute. Morocco were the first African or Arab side to get out of a group.

ball.q: The 1974 World Cup final kicked off late because something was missing from the pitch. What?
ball.sub: They had been taken away for the closing ceremony and nobody put them back.

ball.q: The Netherlands and Ireland finished the 1990 World Cup group with identical records. How were they separated?
ball.sub: The Dutch lost the draw and came third. They had drawn all three group games.

ball.q: Who took charge of the Netherlands after the 2026 World Cup, their first foreign manager since 1978?
ball.sub: Ronald Koeman resigned the day after the round of 32 exit on penalties to Morocco.

ball.q: Spain's old nickname La Furia Espanola was coined in 1920 by a newspaper from which country?
ball.sub: A Dutch headline at the Antwerp Olympics played on the Spanish sack of Antwerp in 1576.

ball.q: Argentina did something in the 2026 World Cup final that no team had done before. What?
ball.a: They did not have a single shot in the first 90 minutes
ball.sub: Spain outshot them 20 to 3. Emiliano Martinez made 11 saves, a record for a World Cup final.
